goal: Allow REST clients to retrieve block headers from stale branches
Enables tracing ancestor headers during chain reorganizations without falling back to RPC
agreement: Supports using query parameters to solve the use case without adding a new endpoint (jeanpablojp)
Nonblocking objection: parameter requirements add REST API weirdness over a dedicated endpoint (0xB10C)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it fills an interface gap that forces external REST clients to fall back to RPC
Allows tools like fork observers to inspect stale headers and follow reorgs directly via REST
